Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the investment options of the Washington state investment board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to investments by the Washington state investmentboard; and adding a new section to chapter 43.33A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.33A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section, "pharmaceutical manufacturingcompany" means an entity that is engaged in the production,preparation, propagation, compounding, conversion, or processing ofprescription drugs, either directly or indirectly, by extraction fromsubstances of natural origin, or independently by means of chemicalsynthesis, or by a combination of extraction and chemical synthesis, orany entity engaged in the packaging, repackaging, labeling, relabeling,or distribution of prescription drugs. This term does not includepharmacists licensed under this chapter, or pharmacy operations of anyintegrated delivery system undertaken for the benefit of patientsobtaining care through that system. (2) The state investment board may not invest in a pharmaceuticalmanufacturing company that: p. 1 HB 1885 (a) Restricts the supply of one or more prescription drugs toCanada in response to the reimportation of a prescription drug into theUnited States; or (b) Sells any of their prescription drugs in the United States ata rate that is more than ten percent higher than the price they chargein Canada.
